items.title: Dalton Richards Interview, 1961-03-16
items.q: My mother played, my older sister played

ctx.x: I'll put down the date on here. It's March the 16th, 1961, and we're at the home of Mr. Dalton Richards, is that right? That's right. Could you give your full name? Do you have any middle initial or middle name? Dalton E. Richards. Do you mind telling just when you were born and where it was? May 27th, 1908. What part of the city was right here in New Orleans? At 2519 Second Street. Uptown. Could you tell us anything about your early music experience? Did your mother and father play any instrument or sing or have…

My mother played, my older sister played, and my sister, the next to the older sister, played... What instrument? Piano. My oldest brother played piano. My next to the oldest brother played piano. Uh, my brother George, he played trumpet. Oh, somebody wants to see. I'll turn it off for a minute.
See, you were telling about all your family played piano. You had a piano right in your home then.
